what: The lane's ONE Host boot was spent on 2026-11-04T15:36-15:39Z. It aborted at post-boot, before any row was measured. The cause is a DRIVER defect, not a product finding.

defect.before: const { rows, config, paths } = rowsFor(...)  // rows emitted, never handed to the World
defect.after: world.u6Fs.rows.push(...rows) — placed BEFORE homePin/mock/spawn, with a comment naming this failure
defect.why_plan_was_green: --plan checks the EMITTED patch text (`emitPatchLayer`) and the row identity, not whether the driver hands that row array to the World the harness boots. The composed profile the Host actually read carried only the base bundle.
proving_artifacts: attempt-1-composed-profile.patch.yml — the profile the Host booted from: canary + probe rows + session-log toggles ONLY. No `a5sf-search-realm`, no `dsh-agent-team`, no `p6t6-team-tools`, no preset declaration.
run.log (15:36:59Z line) — the driver's own log shows the four rows were BUILT: `rows: a5sf-search-realm,dsh-agent-team,p6t6-team-tools,preset-a5sf-search-base`
attempt-1-instance.log — the Host printed its URL and nothing else: the web server listened, but the preludes the rows would have added (the p6t6 route, the Team row) were never composed
run.log (15:39:18Z) — `p6t6 health=false hostAlive=true` after the 120s poll, then `FAILURE at stage post-boot: the p6t6 harness route never answered`

outcome.run_record: overall=FAIL, 6/6 FAIL with reason DRIVER_ABORTED_AT_post-boot — the fail-closed encoding: a Host was reached, so an abort may NOT be laundered into NOT_REACHED, and no row may be read as a product verdict
outcome.product_finding: NONE. No Member was created, no realm was installed, no search process ran. The six rows are UNMEASURED.

ledger.invariant: bootRows(1) === plannedStarts(1) - aborts(0) — the invariant holds

cleanup.note: verified after the run: /dev/tcp probe refused, `tests/homes/` empty, `ps` shows no process carrying the World home/workspace

net_added_for_this_class.dry_run_check: driver: the composed rows are GIVEN to the World (not only emitted) — asserts `world.u6Fs.rows.push(...rows)` appears BEFORE `harness.boot(`
net_added_for_this_class.negative_control: driver: the dry run must notice rows that are emitted but NEVER given to the World — replaces the line with `void rows`, requires dry-run RED on that check, restores the bytes

budget.retry: NOT AUTHORISED. A second boot needs the coordinator's explicit ruling; the driver refuses it itself (`DEDICATED_STARTS = 1`) and the go/no-go gate refuses it (ONE-ATTEMPT rule).
